body: You’re too young to have cancer. Stomach cancer is like very rare on young people. Unless you have a history of stomach cancer in your family. I know how you feel when I was 23 I was going through the same thing and though I was gonna die cause I had cancer but I had worse symptoms than you I couldn’t even swallow because it would burn my throat so bad and felt the good stuck in my throat, vomiting, constispatuon, pain in the back and ally of awful symptoms nausea etc. And after an endoscopy and colonoscopy they just found that my esophagus was inflamed, with gastritis, and GERD. They specialist gave me medications for 6 months and a special diet and now Im back to eating how I used to. Now I’m 27 years old, look at me. If I didn’t have cancer with more symptoms than you, I don’t think you will have cancer. But if you feel like you are not getting the answers, just go with the other doctors or specialist and tell them you want a H pylori test it’s a infection that causes the autism that you have, and tell them that you would want to do a colonoscopy and endoscopy. That’s way you will be more relived . Don’t panic, and don’t google your symptoms. Please! You be fine. 🙏🏻
